description: Query live prediction market odds & real-money implied probabilities (%) from Polymarket and Manifold Markets for any crypto, macro-economic, political, or technology event.

limit.description: Number of markets to return (1-15, default: 5)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

query.description: Event or topic to search (e.g., 'bitcoin', 'fed rate', 'AI', 'election')

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: prediction_markets
